item.text: {"hypothesis_status":"not_supported","summary":"L013 executed successfully but was not an eligible improvement. Its pooled weighted OOF MAE was 7.9882 K, 0.2356 K worse than A05's 7.7526 K and above the required improvement threshold of 7.7426 K. It also failed the deterministic positive-Tc guard: 8.9496 K exceeded the fixed G01 limit of 8.8322 K by 0.1175 K. Relative to G01, selectively fitting cluster2 slightly improved reported-zero MAE from 5.8697 K to 5.8521 K, but worsened positive-Tc MAE from 8.8322 K to 8.9496 K, while high-Tc MAE was unchanged at 32.7716 K because cluster2 contains no high-Tc rows. Thus cluster2's low absolute route MAE did not imply an improvement over global fallback; it produced another zero-versus-positive tradeoff and cannot be called a guard-eligible win.","next_action":"continue","next_focus":"Because only 13 of 22 required successful unique cycles are complete, test the untried complementary kmeans3 ablation with composition input, global extra_trees/raw, and only a cluster0 extra_trees/raw expert; cluster1 and cluster2 should fall back to the global model. L013 rejects cluster2-only specialization, while L012 showed that the combined three-expert configuration was substantially worse; isolating cluster0 will determine whether it contributes useful routing signal independently of cluster1. The hypothesis is falsified as an eligible improvement unless pooled weighted OOF MAE is below 7.742598770753422 K and positive-Tc MAE is at most 8.832165507919859 K. Any route or subgroup gain without both conditions is only a tradeoff.","stop_reason":"","limitations":["All measurements are adaptive development evidence from reused fixed-group training OOF folds, not independent validation or proof of generalization.","L013 failed the fixed positive-Tc guard and therefore is ineligible regardless of its reported-zero improvement.","Cluster2's favorable absolute route MAE reflects an easier low-temperature partition and does not establish benefit relative to global fallback.","KMeans cluster identities may shift between folds, and the routing partitions are operational composition rules rather than verified physical families.","The largest opposing zero/high-Tc errors remain in cluster1, and no new superconductors are identified."]}
